# Muhammad Saad - Android Developer Portfolio

> Muhammad Saad is a native Android developer specializing in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM Clean Architecture, Room Database, and Firebase backend systems.

## Core Expertise
- **Role**: Android Developer / Mobile Software Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room SQLite, Coroutines, Hilt, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage, FCM), Flutter
- **Education**: Bachelor of Software Engineering, COMSATS University Islamabad, Sahiwal Campus (Graduated July 2026)
- **Certifications**: Meta Android Developer Certificate, Google UX Design Professional Certificate

## Portfolio Projects & Technical Case Studies
- [GiveEase Case Study](https://saadev.site/blog/giveease-case-study): Engineering breakdown of a verified Android donation platform using Kotlin, Firebase Firestore, and MVVM architecture.
- [SpendWise Case Study](https://saadev.site/blog/spendwise-case-study): Technical architecture guide for an offline-first Android expense tracker using Room SQLite database and Jetpack Compose.
- [Jetpack Compose vs XML Article](https://saadev.site/blog/jetpack-compose-vs-xml): Performance and syntax comparison between declarative compose layouts and imperative XML view hierarchies.
- [Dev-Journal Android Repository](https://github.com/chsaad-dev/Dev-Journal-Android): Social publishing platform for developers to write Markdown posts, follow peers, and engage in real-time. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material3, MVVM Clean Architecture (46 use cases), Hilt, Cloud Firestore, Room DB, Cloudflare FCM, and Next.js admin panel.
- [GupShup Android Repository](https://github.com/chsaad-dev/GupShup): Real-time Android messaging and status application with offline-first Room cache, 5-minute freshness policy, dynamic notification channel versioning, and serverless Cloudflare Worker FCM v1 push delivery.
- [NoteSync Repository](https://github.com/chsaad-dev/NoteSync): Offline-first encrypted notes application built with Flutter, Riverpod, Isar DB, and AES biometrics.
